translations.signIn.heading: Sign in
translations.signIn.lead: Sign in to manage your workspace and the AI agents that answer on your behalf.
translations.session.ended: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue where you were.
translations.auth.email.label: Email address
translations.signIn.email.error: Enter the email address you signed up with.
translations.auth.password.label: Password
translations.signIn.resetNote: Password reset is not available yet. Contact an administrator if you cannot sign in.
translations.register.heading: Create your account
translations.register.lead: Your account signs you in. You will choose or create a workspace next.
translations.register.email.hint: This is the address you will sign in with.
translations.register.note: Email addresses are not verified yet, and there is no password reset. Keep your password somewhere safe.
translations.register.password.hint: At least {$count} characters. A memorable phrase works well.
translations.websiteChat.security.frame: The chat runs in a frame served by Nabra, so the site it is embedded in cannot read the conversation, cannot read the visitor's session, and cannot style or script anything inside it. Nothing about your workspace, your agent or your knowledge is sent to the page.
translations.lab.title: Design Lab
translations.lab.intro: "Two Voices", the whole system on one page. Development builds only. Every name, number and message here is sample content, written for this page.
translations.lab.colour.note: Values are read live from the page, so they are the ones this theme actually resolved. Lagoon means the AI and Ember means a person; neither is ever decoration or status.
translations.lab.colour.sideBySide: Voice and status, side by side
translations.lab.colour.sideBySide.note: Ember (a person) is orange, warning is a yellow amber, danger is crimson. Each carries its own glyph and word, so none depends on its hue.
translations.lab.type.note: Instrument Sans (headings narrowed to 86%) and IBM Plex Sans Arabic, both self-hosted. Figures are tabular and stay Western in both languages.
translations.lab.shape.card: A card: a hairline, no shadow.
translations.lab.shape.overlay: An overlay: the only thing that casts a shadow.
translations.lab.icons.note: One authored 24px outline set, 1.6 stroke with round joins. Channel glyphs are generic and always shown with the channel's name; no brand logo is recoloured. Arrows and chevrons turn round in a right-to-left page.
translations.lab.mark.note: Two speech shapes, two voices in one tone: the AI and the team. Never mirrored.
translations.lab.buttons.note: Hover, press and focus are live: point at them, or press Tab.
translations.lab.forms.agentName.hint: Shown to customers as the sender of AI replies.
translations.lab.forms.greeting.placeholder: For example: Hi, how can I help?
translations.lab.forms.address.error: Use lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens.
translations.lab.content.card.subtitle: A grouping device, not a default wrapper.
translations.lab.content.card.body: Cards are white on the porcelain page, edged by a hairline.
translations.lab.content.menu.label: Sample menu
translations.lab.feedback.info: Sample: indexing runs in the background.
translations.lab.feedback.warning: Sample: the plan's message limit is close.
translations.lab.feedback.danger: Sample: the document could not be read.
translations.lab.feedback.stale.title: Sample: someone else changed this agent
translations.lab.feedback.stale.body: Your edits are still here. Review the newer version, or keep yours.
translations.lab.dialog.handBack.heading: Sample: hand this conversation back to the AI?
translations.lab.dialog.handBack.body: The AI answers the next customer message. You can take it over again at any time.
translations.lab.dialog.delete.heading: Sample: delete this document?
translations.lab.dialog.delete.body: Agents stop using it at once. This cannot be undone.
translations.lab.empty.heading: Sample: no conversations yet
translations.lab.empty.description: They appear here as soon as a customer writes on a connected channel.
translations.lab.error.heading: Sample: this list could not be loaded
translations.lab.error.description: Nothing was changed. Check the connection and try again.
translations.lab.voices.takeOver.note: The same chip changes voice: a 320ms sweep on the emphasized curve, instant under reduced motion.
translations.lab.voices.track: Voice track (from the sample transcript below)
translations.lab.type.caption: Caption
translations.lab.toast.error: Sample: the change could not be saved. Nothing was lost; try again.
translations.invitation.reading.heading: Opening your invitation…
translations.invitation.invited.heading: You have been invited
translations.invitation.invited.lead: A team has invited you to join their workspace on Nabra. Sign in with the address this invitation was sent to, or create an account with it, and you will join straight away.
translations.invitation.keepTab: Keep this tab open. If you close it, open your invitation link again.
translations.invitation.accepting.heading: Joining the workspace…
translations.invitation.accepted.heading: You are in
translations.invitation.accepted.roles: What you can do there depends on the roles you were given. An administrator can change them at any time.
translations.invitation.failed.heading: This invitation cannot be used
translations.invitation.missingCode: This invitation link is missing its code. Open the link you were sent again, or ask for a new invitation.
translations.invitation.otherAccount: This invitation was sent to a different account. Sign out and open the link again as the address it was sent to.
translations.notFound.state.title: Nothing at this address
translations.notFound.state.description: The link may be out of date or mistyped. Nothing in your workspace has changed.
translations.notFound.heading: Page not found
translations.notFound.description: The address you followed does not match any page in Nabra.
translations.notificationPreferences.inAppNote: In-app notifications are always on. Email is off unless you turn a category on here, and it is only ever sent to your own account's address. Emails never contain report files — they link to Nabra, where you sign in as usual.

translations.entry.example.caption: Example conversation
translations.entry.example.question: Can I still return a jacket I bought three weeks ago?
translations.entry.example.answer: Yes. Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery, unworn and with the tags on.
translations.entry.example.followUp: The zip broke on the first day. Can someone take a look?
translations.entry.example.reply: I am sorry about that. I will send you a replacement today.
